Index of openwashdata R Data Packages
text: Three functions return catalog tibbles. owd_packages() lists one row per package. owd_datasets() lists one row per dataset, package belongs . owd_variables() lists one row per variable, dataset belongs . owd_search("water") finds packages, datasets variables whose name description match pattern. owd_install("washmalawi") installs listed package openwashdata R-universe, CRAN fallback.
